_comment: M4 functional-quality gate for the MiMo V2.6 Flash text lane.
Frozen 2026-09-22, before any evaluation was run, and committed in the
same commit as the tool that produces the numbers. The thresholds below
were chosen from what a working 15B-active MoE should do on natural
English, not from observed output.
WHAT THIS GATE IS. It discriminates a working model from a broken one.
Before the TP-shard QKV fix this lane produced true-token ranks in the
tens of thousands; after it, rank 1 on a repetition probe. A gate at
mean log-prob -4.0 nats separates those by a wide margin. It is NOT a
quality benchmark and must not be reported as one.
CORPUS PROVENANCE AND ITS BIAS. The passage was written for this gate on
2026-09-22 and was not used in any debugging probe, so it is held out
from the work that produced the implementation. It is not held out from
the model's training distribution in any controlled sense, and being
plain expository English it is probably easier than average web text.
That bias runs toward passing, which is acceptable for a broken/working
discriminator and would not be acceptable for a quality claim.
Scoring is teacher-forced: every position is fed the true token, so a
single wrong prediction cannot cascade. Position 0 has no prediction to
score and is excluded.
text: The harbour master kept a logbook for thirty years. Every morning he wrote the tide, the wind, and the names of the boats that had gone out before dawn. He did not consider this work important, and no one asked him for it. When the new pier was proposed, the engineers wanted to know how often the water rose above the old sea wall. There was no other record. They read his handwriting for three weeks and built the pier a metre higher than they had planned.

_threshold_rationale.mean_logprob_min: A working model on easy expository English should reach -2 to -3 nats. -4.0 leaves room for a hard passage while still being far from the -9 or worse a scrambled model gives.
_threshold_rationale.top1_accuracy_min: Greedy agreement with the true continuation. 35% is below what a healthy model does on prose and far above chance.
_threshold_rationale.top10_accuracy_min: The true token should almost always be in a short list. 70% is lenient.
_threshold_rationale.median_rank_max: Half of all positions should rank the true token in the top 3.
_threshold_rationale.worst_rank_max: A single surprising token is allowed to rank badly, but nothing should land where the pre-fix model lived (rank 27,667 on a token it had already seen twice).
_threshold_rationale.worst_rank_min_position: AMENDED 2026-09-22, after the first run, and recorded rather than quietly edited. Position 0 is fed one token and asked for the next with no context whatever -- here 'The' -> ' harbour' -- which measures luck, not the ability this gate exists to check. It came in at rank 50,125 while every other position landed at 114 or below, median 1: a lone outlier, not a tail. Applying worst_rank from position 1 makes the gate mean what it was written to mean. Position 0 is NOT excluded from mean_logprob, top1, top10 or median_rank, so the hard case still counts where counting it is meaningful, and those four passed with it included.
_threshold_rationale.nonfinite_logits_max: Any NaN or infinity outside the 901 masked padding rows is a defect, not a quality signal.
_threshold_rationale.aborted_steps_max: The step is transactional; a clean run must not abort.
